info.description:
BioModels is a repository of mathematical models of biological and biomedical systems. It hosts a vast selection of existing literature-based physiologically and pharmaceutically relevant mechanistic models in standard formats. Our mission is to provide the systems modelling community with reproducible, high-quality, freely-accessible models published in the scientific literature. More information about BioModels can be found in the FAQ.

Notes about this API

Content negotiation

Both XML and JSON MIME types are supported. Clients have two ways of specifying the content type:

  • an explicit format request parameter (e.g. format=xml)
  • the Accept request header (e.g. Accept: application/xml).
If both are specified, the format parameter has priority.

BioModels content

Model information is retrieved based on the a submission identifier, such as MODEL1707110000, or a BioModels identifier, like BIOMD0000000123. BioModels content is versioned and model revision numbers are assigned incrementally starting from 1. If a particular model revision is public, it can be accessed by appending a dot ('.') and its number to the model identifier (e.g. BIOMD0000000123.1).

The Path2Models branch of models is not available through this API at this time.

get.summary: Download a particular file associated with a given model or all its files as a COMBINE archive. The Content disposition and MIME type response headers contain the file name and type.

parameters.name: modelId
parameters.description: The model identifier that the file in question is associated with

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The name of the file that needs to be downloaded. If not provided, all model files are returned as a COMBINE archive. If the file name is set, then the file contents will be served.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query. Please note that the colon character in ontology terms must be escaped.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set

parameters.name: numResults
parameters.description: The number of items to return

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The format that the response should return

get.summary: Search for parameters of a model

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: A query to search against the model parameter values.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description:
It is the offset of the result set, please enter the number of records to skip.
Default value = 0

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The number of items to display per page. Default value = 10

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
The column name and sort direction to perform the sort operation, Sortable column: model.
Default value = model:ascending

parameters.name: responseformat
parameters.description: The format of the result (CSV,JSON). Default value = JSON

publication.description: An identifiers.org URI to the model's publication.

submissionId.description: The identifier assigned to the model when it was submitted to BioModels

publicationId.description: The identifier assigned to the model when it was published in the curated branch of BioModels.

firstPublished.description: The date when the model first became publicly available in BioModels
